The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:billing_dispute: Billing disputes always go to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.

{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Ticket:
Confused about duplicate charge on monthly invoice

Hi, I'm looking over our latest subscription invoice and I'm a bit confused because it looks like we were billed twice for this month. We are a small practice and only have the essentials tier, so this duplicate charge doesn't seem right. Could someone look into this and refund the extra amount to our account?

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the duplicate charge on your recent invoice. I understand how concerning this can be, and I want to assure you that a member of our support team is reviewing the details of your account.

We’ll investigate the billing discrepancy and get back to you as soon as we have more information.

If you have any additional details you’d like to share in the meantime, please feel free to reply to this message.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
